message:
The other night, we had a surprise blackout that left the whole neighborhood in darkness. I rummaged through my drawers and found my trusty power bank, which I had charged just the other week. With my phone powered up, I could check for updates and keep my favorite playlist going on low volume. 

It turned into a cozy little evening, complete with snacks and some family games by the glow of my battery-operated lantern. I realized that a little prep can turn a potentially frustrating situation into a fun memory. 

What’s your go-to tip for staying comfortable during a power outage? I’d love to hear your ideas! 😊
